## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed (`git commit -s`, DCO)
- [ ] No em dash or en dash (use a comma, a semicolon, parentheses, or `--`)
- [ ] No secrets in the diff, the log, or the description
- [ ] Test deploys stay on a `workers.dev` address (a zone needs a CR issue)
